content: Oblique Audio RTL Utility (Andrew Jerrim, free macOS/Windows, v1.0 Oct 2021): pick device, sample rate, buffer, press Measure; loopback pulse out->in; reports samples+ms; repeatable within 1-2 samples (SOS). Audio-only, no MIDI. Peers: CEntrance LTU, MathAudio Latency Meter (free plug-in, correlation method, 0.01ms, latency tier labels, Jul 2026), RMAA, REW, jack_delay (13-tone phase, ~1/1000 sample).
